name: Gasthaus Zur schönen Aussicht
beschreibung: The Gasthaus Zur schönen Aussicht in Rettenschöss is a traditional Tyrolean inn. Its scenic location offers wonderful views of the surrounding mountain landscape. The atmosphere in the house is down-to-earth and steeped in regional hospitality. Guests can look forward to comfortable accommodation in simple guest rooms. Amenities include a restaurant serving classic Tyrolean fare and a sun terrace. The surrounding countryside invites visitors to enjoy scenic hikes in nature. The inn is well suited for travellers who appreciate tranquillity and authenticity.
